author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಭಾವಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮತೆಯರಿತು ನಡೆಯುತಿರಲಾಗಿ
ಆವರಿಪ ಮಾಯೆಯನು ಕಳೆಯಲಾದೀತು
ನಾವಿಕನು ಮುಂಬರುವ ವಿಪರೀತವೂಹಿಸಿರೆ
ಜೀವಗಳ ರಕ್ಷಿಪನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you walk knowing the subtleties of feeling,
you can dispel the illusion that closes in;
a sailor who foresees the storm ahead
saves the lives on board, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Sensitivity to feelings, our own and others’, helps us see through illusion. Like a sailor who reads the weather, we can steer safely by anticipating what is coming.
